name: linear-tracker-adapter
title: Linear is a tracker adapter beside beads
outcome: A repo sets adapter: linear in .cobuilder/tracker.yaml and every tracker.py operation works against Linear. People plan epics and slices in Linear, and CoBuilder builds from that plan and writes progress back. Beads stays unchanged.
done_when: the shared contract test passes on the linear adapter over a fake Linear. Each tracker.py operation answers in the JSON shape of the fake adapter
the beads adapter files and the beads tests show no diff and no new failure
an envelope with scalars, a path, and a list of paths round-trips through an attachment, and a value-level compare finds no difference
set-slice-state moves the Linear workflow state through the states map. A skipped slice moves to the canceled state, and a renamed state of the same type still maps
a slice issue in Linear shows its state word, score, and attempts. A program issue shows its gate dates and stage. A pull request shows as a linked issue
a claim writes its attachment first. Only the earlier server time writes the assignee. The loser and a held slice get a refusal. A claim ends when in progress ends
next-ready returns a slice when each blocker is closed and its epic has no open blocker. It never returns a pull request or an unplanned issue
a reorder, rename, or re-parent in the fake Linear shows in plan_changes with the field, old value, and new value. Writes by CoBuilder alone raise none
an issue that a person creates in Linear lists as unplanned and is never ready. regenerate-status-files and the projector skip it without error
a second seed-from-files run changes nothing. The seed reports a plan field that differs from Linear as a conflict and does not overwrite it
regenerate-status-files rewrites the state lines of 00-status.md and 04-slices.md from Linear records
a full read of 265 issues makes no more than 8 requests, and a rate-limit answer gives exit 3 with the reset time
a missing LINEAR_API_KEY gives exit 3 and names the variable, and a grep finds no key in the repo
a grep finds no Linear API call outside shared/tracker_port/linear*.py, and no skill or command names one
a slice that a person moves to Done with no passing score reads as open, and next-ready does not unblock the next slice
a canceled slice reads as closed only with the outcome skipped, and an epic reads as closed only when all its slices do
a full read returns an archived closed slice, and ready counts it as a closed blocker
set-slice-state open removes the claim attachments and the assignee. A claim on a slice with a stale claim succeeds. doctor lists each held claim with its claimant and age
doctor warns when the team auto-closes child issues or stale issues, if the key can read those settings
capabilities report rich_envelope true, and native_ready, atomic_claim, and offline_read false
a live smoke test in a test workspace passes the four unverified rows and the archived read. The default run skips it, and no earlier step needs it
cobuilder-setup offers linear only after the smoke test passes. It asks for the team and project, checks the key, and asks approval before prepare. The install test passes
abort_if: the smoke test shows that attachment metadata cannot round-trip the envelope without loss
the smoke test shows that Linear cannot keep a program, epic, and slice tree with slice order, and the project fallback fails too
a full read of the normal backlog costs more requests or complexity than the hourly limits allow for the normal build loop
the port needs a field that only Linear can serve, and no capability flag can cover it

min_work.derived_from: 2 districts (shared, implement), 8 ADRs, 1 boundary rule (bd only in the beads adapter), 1 repo rule to amend (principle 7), 1 install step

epics.outcome: The linear adapter reads the plan from a fake Linear. The contract read cases pass, a close counts only with proof, archived issues stay in the read, and a full read of 265 issues takes 8 requests or fewer
A slice result, a program stage, an epic branch, and a pull request show in the fake Linear, and the write cases of the contract suite pass
Next-ready follows the slice and epic order, one claim wins, and a crashed claim can end
A change by a person shows at the next sync, a second seed changes nothing, and shared code skips unplanned issues
The adapter note, the usage keys, the boundary record, and the grep guard match the code, and principle 7 allows the tracker call
The unverified rows pass in a test workspace, and the notes state whether an abort rule fires
cobuilder-setup offers linear after the smoke test passes, and asks approval before prepare
